capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-CANCEL-001 authority on session/task/plan/obligation
capabilities.safeAlternative: request task owner or supervisor to initiate drain/cancel transition

capabilities.capability: create/revise investigations, hypotheses, probes, and findings
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-CASE-WRITE-001 authority on mission/case scope
capabilities.safeAlternative: request mission investigation role or record local hypotheses

capabilities.capability: read minimal evidence/decision subgraphs and counterfactuals
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-EXPLAIN-001 authority on authorized decision/evidence domain
capabilities.safeAlternative: request explanation access role or query top-level outcome summary

capabilities.capability: append correction, adjudication, outcome, or learning proposal
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-FEEDBACK-001 authority on episode/event/case
capabilities.safeAlternative: request feedback role or submit offline evaluation report

capabilities.capability: publish a redacted root-last handoff capsule
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-HANDOFF-WRITE-001 authority on mission/workspace + recipient scope
capabilities.safeAlternative: request handoff delegation authorization or retain session locally

capabilities.capability: submit an exact prepared plan to domain effect authorities
capabilities.defaultRole: denied unless explicit; never substitutes for domain effect capabilities
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-PLAN-COMMIT-001 authority on plan digest + fences
capabilities.safeAlternative: submit prepared plan to human supervisor for manual approval and domain dispatch

capabilities.capability: compile and seal a witnessed contingent plan
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-PLAN-PREPARE-001 authority on mission + objective + target domain
capabilities.safeAlternative: request planner role or inspect established affordance frontier

capabilities.capability: compile and execute bounded semantic queries
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-QUERY-001 authority on authorized resources + anchor
capabilities.safeAlternative: request agent query role or query standard pre-aggregated views

capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-SESSION-OPEN-001 authority on deployment + mission + principal
capabilities.safeAlternative: authenticate principal credentials and negotiate session contract basis

capabilities.capability: read/resume exact workspace or handoff revisions
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-SESSION-READ-001 authority on mission/session/workspace root
capabilities.safeAlternative: authenticate as session principal or request delegated continuation

capabilities.capability: read capability-projected SituationFrames, deltas, and obligations
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-SITUATION-READ-001 authority on deployment/mission/zone/time
capabilities.safeAlternative: request agent read role or query minimal public SituationCapsule

capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-REPAIR-PREPARE-001 authority on subsystem/object scope
capabilities.safeAlternative: request operator repair inspection role or run read-only diagnostics

errors.description: learning proposal lacks evidence, applicability, counterexamples, or validation path

errors.description: no safe, authorized, useful next action exists under current evidence/budget

errors.description: presentation attempted an unregistered verb/view or changed semantic meaning

errors.description: external effects/obligations prevent a truthful resumed terminal state

errors.description: session, workspace, or resumed handoff basis no longer satisfies required anchor/generation/freshness semantics

errors.description: CLI/MCP/TUI/report semantic payload or digest differs for equivalent input

errors.description: requested multi-agent work scope overlaps an incompatible live claim, lease, or fence

errors.description: agent abstraction layer stable identifier was reused, duplicated, renumbered, or tombstoned

errors.description: canonical bytes declare more collection elements than the bytes that remain (truncated buffer)

errors.description: capability registry or markdown documentation file is missing or corrupt
errors.guidance: repair or restore capability registry file

errors.description: capability registry digest does not match canonical encoding of sorted rows
errors.guidance: recompute canonical capability registry digest

errors.description: capability row lacks a default role or default grant policy
errors.guidance: declare an explicit default role or default denial in the capability row

errors.description: capability registry row drift between architecture JSON and markdown
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/capabilities.json and registries/CAPABILITIES.md

errors.description: capability stable identifier was reused or renumbered for a different entity
errors.guidance: allocate a new unique stable identifier; never reuse stable IDs

errors.description: capability specifies an unknown or unregistered semantic plane
errors.guidance: assign a recognized semantic plane to the capability row

errors.description: promoted proof or bounded_model claim declares no assumptions, or an assumption lacks a non-empty id and statement
errors.guidance: declare every named assumption before promotion; no retry without them

errors.description: bounded_model derivation records no usable inputs or arithmetic formula, the formula is not its expression right-hand side, or it does not recompute the derived value
errors.guidance: record every input with value and units and the exact arithmetic yielding the derived value

errors.description: bounded_model claim derivation is missing, not on disk, digest-unbound, malformed, stepless, or not bound to the claim id and generation
errors.guidance: retain the fss.bound_derivation.v1 derivation bound to the claim before promotion

errors.description: bounded_model derivation formula is dimensionally inconsistent (+ or - of different units, or propagated units differ from the derivation units)
errors.guidance: correct the formula or input units; units are never converted implicitly

errors.description: bounded_model claim bound expression, comparator, or value is missing, non-finite, bound to another claim, or differs from the derivation
errors.guidance: bind the exact derived bound expression to the claim

errors.description: bounded_model derivation declares no sensitivity analysis or no invalidators
errors.guidance: retain sensitivity analysis and invalidators with the derivation

errors.description: bounded_model claimed bound is tighter than the analytically derived bound
errors.guidance: claim at most the derived bound or retain a derivation supporting the tighter one

errors.description: bounded_model claim bound or derivation declares no units, or the claimed units differ from the derivation units
errors.guidance: declare identical explicit units in claim and derivation; never convert implicitly

errors.description: bounded_model claimed, derived, or input value lies outside its registered unit domain (negative, above 100 percent, above 1 auprc)
errors.guidance: correct the value or its unit

errors.description: promoted claim of a class the checker does not realize with evidence inspection (only slo, proof, bounded_model are realized)
errors.guidance: realize the class row or keep the claim unpromoted

errors.description: a registry binding claim ids to classes (architecture/invariants.json) declares an inexact id or one id more than once
errors.guidance: give every stable id exactly one row

errors.description: a promoted proof bundle's claim id is bound to a claim class by no registry (SLO ids by registries/SLOS.md, invariant ids by architecture/invariants.json); a row Class column or the bundle never resolves it
errors.guidance: bind the claim id in its owning registry; no retry until one does

errors.description: a JSON document the claim checker reads (proof bundle, qualification receipt, retained evidence document, or registry, including every architecture/*.json the stable-ID tombstone index reads, which leaves the index unavailable) declares the same key twice in one object, at any nesting level; with a plain parser the last value would silently win
errors.guidance: declare every key once; a document that says two things is never read as one of them

errors.description: an evidence document the claim checker reads declares a key outside its exact field set: the proof bundle, an artifact entry, an assumption, the theorem, the toolchain identity, the formal model reference, manifest, or model source, the proof check receipt, the bound, the derivation, a derivation input, a sensitivity entry, an slo measurement, or its measurement_window; or a qualification receipt declares a case, whitespace, or format-character variant of a field the checker relies on. Keys are compared byte for byte (no case folding, stripping, or normalization)
errors.guidance: remove the key or spell it exactly as the document's field set names it; unknown fields are never ignored

errors.description: promoted proof or bounded_model claim is cited by no claim row declaring its current generation (Generation column), or its citing rows conflict
errors.guidance: declare the claim row's current generation and bind the bundle to exactly it

errors.description: a proof bundle's schema is missing or not exactly `fss.proof_bundle.v1`, or its bundle_id is present but not an exact token
errors.guidance: declare the schema byte for byte and, when present, a bundle_id of printable ASCII with no whitespace

errors.description: proof check receipt is missing, malformed, non-passing, or not bound to the claim, formal model, and formal artifact digest
errors.guidance: re-run the formal checker and retain a passing bound receipt

errors.description: proof claim formal artifact is absent, not on disk, empty, digest-unbound, or not written in the declared checker language
errors.guidance: retain the exact checked formal artifact before promotion

errors.description: proof claim declares no formal model, or its retained fss.formal_model.v1 manifest or source is missing, unreadable, digest-unbound, or not bound to the claim id
errors.guidance: retain the declared formal model bound to the claim id before promotion

errors.description: proof claim formal model generation differs from the claim generation, the declared model reference, or the check receipt
errors.guidance: re-check the proof at the claim generation; never splice generations

errors.description: promoted proof bundle passed the static pre-filter, but a proof is verified only by a qualification receipt from running the prover, and no such receipt mechanism is defined yet
errors.guidance: a user decision: define the prover-run receipt; until then no proof claim is verified

errors.description: proof bundle references a stale, superseded, tombstoned, expired, or latest-aliased generation, or a generation other than its claim row's current one
errors.guidance: re-qualify at the current generation; never splice generations

errors.description: proof claim is backed only by tests (test-runner toolchain, test source, or test results) instead of a formal artifact
errors.guidance: demote the claim or supply a machine-checked formal proof

errors.description: proof claim theorem statement is missing, bound to another claim, or differs from the statement the check receipt checked
errors.guidance: bind the exact theorem statement to the claim and re-check

errors.description: proof claim formal checker identity is missing, unregistered, latest-aliased, or differs between bundle and check receipt
errors.guidance: pin the exact registered formal checker and version in bundle and receipt

errors.description: proof claim formal artifact contains, outside comments and strings, an unproven placeholder (Lean sorry, sorryAx, admit, stop or a confusable lookalike; TLAPS OMITTED in any case)
errors.guidance: complete the proof; a placeholder is never a checked proof

errors.description: proof claim formal artifact contains a known unsound escape (Lean axiom, compiler trust, lcProof, kernel bypass, metaprogramming, a #-command, an import outside Init/Std/Lean; TLA+ AXIOM, ASSUMPTION or non-sequent ASSUME, or EXTENDS/INSTANCE of a non-standard module)
errors.guidance: remove the escape; declare assumptions in the bundle and model

errors.description: slo measurement has no single canonical numeric 'actual': it is missing, non-numeric, boolean, negative, overflowing, or rounded-only (an actual-like key is ERR-CLAIM-EVIDENCE-FIELD-UNKNOWN-001)
errors.guidance: retain exactly one finite, non-negative numeric 'actual' in the SLO unit; never report only a rounded value

errors.description: slo measurement declares a comparator that differs from the comparator of its registries/SLOS.md row
errors.guidance: remove the comparator from the measurement; the SLO row alone defines the comparison

errors.description: the measurements behind one slo claim come from different operations, or their validity windows share no common instant
errors.guidance: measure every conjunct of the SLO target on the same operation within overlapping validity windows

errors.description: slo claim retains no single digest-bound fss.environment_manifest.v1 artifact, or the measurement is not bound to that manifest's digest
errors.guidance: retain the exact environment manifest and bind the measurement to its digest

errors.description: an operation-cost row listing the slo claim's SLO declares no measurement_max_age_days (the strictest bound over all such rows applies), so the freshness bound is unset
errors.guidance: a user decision: set the bound on every such row; the checker never assumes a default

errors.description: slo bundle or measurement declares no generation, or the measurement declares no operation-cost registry generation
errors.guidance: bind the bundle and measurement to one explicit generation and to the operation-cost registry generation measured against

errors.description: slo measurement status is missing or anything other than 'passed'
errors.guidance: re-run the measurement; a failed, partial, or unlabelled run never supports an slo claim

errors.description: the SLO registry (registries/SLOS.md) or operation-cost registry (architecture/operation_cost_registry.toml) consulted for an slo claim is missing, unreadable, empty, malformed, or declares no rows or generation
errors.guidance: repair the registry under the audited root; slo claims are never checked against a silently skipped registry

errors.description: slo measurement's declared statistic is not exactly the statistic its SLO target names (missing, different, not byte-exact, or declared for a target naming none; a statistic-like key is ERR-CLAIM-EVIDENCE-FIELD-UNKNOWN-001)
errors.guidance: declare the single canonical 'statistic' exactly as the SLO target names it, or none when it names none

errors.description: slo claim target cannot be resolved to exactly one numeric threshold of its registries/SLOS.md row, the measurement declares no or a different unit, or the measurement restates a target that differs from the authoritative row (a non-canonical target key is ERR-CLAIM-EVIDENCE-FIELD-UNKNOWN-001)
errors.guidance: claim only an SLO row with a registered numeric threshold; measure in its exact unit and never restate or relax the target

errors.description: slo measurement validity window is missing, unparseable, zone-less, empty, finished before it started, or lies in the future
errors.guidance: retain a zone-qualified ISO-8601 measurement window that ended before the evaluation instant

errors.description: option flag was specified more than once
errors.guidance: specify option at most once

errors.description: command-line argument contains invalid UTF-8 bytes
errors.guidance: encode command-line arguments in UTF-8

errors.description: option or argument value cannot be parsed into expected domain
errors.guidance: provide valid typed value before retry

errors.description: required option or positional argument value is missing
errors.guidance: provide required value before retry

errors.description: runtime error occurred during validated command execution
errors.guidance: inspect diagnostic and address failure cause

errors.description: extra argument provided after command grammar is satisfied
errors.guidance: remove trailing argument before retry

errors.description: positional argument provided to command taking no positionals
errors.guidance: remove unexpected positional argument

errors.description: command token is not a recognized CLI command or verb
errors.guidance: do not retry without valid command name

errors.description: option flag is unrecognized for binary or active command
errors.guidance: do not retry without valid option flag

errors.description: comparison or association between incompatible clock bases
errors.guidance: convert to common basis or synchronise to UTC

errors.description: clock basis name is unrecognized
errors.guidance: supply a registered clock basis name

errors.description: clock synchronization state unknown when synchronised evidence required
errors.guidance: obtain synchronisation certificate or abstain

errors.description: capture interval too wide for requested operation
errors.guidance: degrade/abstain/recalibrate

errors.description: clock unsynchronised or drift bound exceeds tolerance
errors.guidance: synchronise clock or bound monotonic drift

errors.description: effective observability cannot be established
errors.guidance: abstain/escalate health alert

errors.description: media decode failed
errors.guidance: preserve source; alternate decoder only if registered

errors.description: media exceeds declared bounds
errors.guidance: fail closed

errors.description: deletion closure blocked by hold/backend/offline copy
errors.guidance: report exact blockers and obligation

errors.description: architecture/dependency_allowlist.toml bytes diverged from the checker's pinned allowlist digest
errors.guidance: review the allowlist change and update the pinned digest in scripts/dependency_authority.py in the same commit

errors.description: dependency constitution drift between machine registry and markdown documentation, or between DEPENDENCY_CONSTITUTION.md and its docs/ copy
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/dependency_constitution.json and docs/DEPENDENCY_CONSTITUTION.md, and keep docs/DEPENDENCY_CONSTITUTION.md byte-identical to DEPENDENCY_CONSTITUTION.md

errors.description: dependency constitution semantic invariant violated
errors.guidance: enforce constitutional admission rule and production closed-universe invariants

errors.description: Cargo metadata violates constitutional language or stdlib requirements for DEP-CLASS-F0, or names a workspace member that is not declared in architecture/crate_topology.json and listed explicitly in the root [workspace].members
errors.guidance: ensure all workspace crates compile under rust-2024 without foreign links, and declare every member in the crate topology and the explicit workspace member list

errors.description: dependency registry or markdown documentation file is missing or corrupt
errors.guidance: repair or restore dependency registry file

errors.description: dependency registry digest does not match canonical encoding of metadata and rows
errors.guidance: recompute canonical dependency registry digest

errors.description: a toolchain command required for DEP-CLASS-F0 verification (rustc -Vv or cargo metadata) could not run, timed out, exited non-zero, or produced unparseable output
errors.guidance: restore the pinned toolchain and offline cargo inputs and rerun; an execution failure is never reported as a corrupt file

errors.description: dependency registry digest diverged from pinned baseline freeze digest
errors.guidance: restore frozen dependency registry or bump generation

errors.description: dependency registry generation diverged from baseline generation
errors.guidance: assign expected generation to dependency registry

errors.description: dependency class row or root metadata lacks a mandatory field or is empty/corrupt
errors.guidance: declare all mandatory fields in dependency class row

errors.description: a crate recorded under an open owner decision (dependency_allowlist.toml [pending_owner_decisions], e.g. fss-ndxis) reached a manifest, lockfile, or resolved closure
errors.guidance: keep the crate out of the closure until the owner records the decision; it is neither admitted nor rejected meanwhile

errors.description: dependency registry row drift between machine registry and markdown mirror
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/dependencies.json and registries/DEPENDENCIES.md

errors.description: dependency class stable identifier was reused, duplicated, renumbered, or tombstoned
errors.guidance: allocate a new unique stable identifier; never reuse stable IDs

errors.description: a dependency or dependency-class tombstone/supersession record is malformed, contradictory, dangling, or missing
errors.guidance: record status, successor, and tombstone decision consistently in architecture/dependencies.json and architecture/stable_id_resolution.json

errors.description: a dependency registry row's owner, producer, consumer, ContractBasis link, or a dependency checker diagnostic code does not resolve
errors.guidance: name existing repository files and allowlist tables that reference the row, and register every emitted code in registries/ERRORS.md

errors.description: the repository enables a nightly unstable feature (#![feature(...)] including inside cfg_attr, -Z rustflags in .cargo/config or checked-in env/shell files, a cargo [unstable] table, cargo-features, or a -Z literal in a build script) while no unstable-feature allowlist is registered
errors.guidance: remove the feature gate or flag, or register an unstable-feature allowlist with owner and removal plan before enabling it

errors.description: exact product/firmware/app tuple not certified

errors.description: dispatch outcome cannot be determined
errors.guidance: reconcile before retry

errors.description: canonical root references unavailable required evidence
errors.guidance: repair; no adjudication requiring it

errors.description: observed device generation differs from registry
errors.guidance: disable/move to shadow; no optimistic retry

errors.description: frozen public registry digest does not match canonical encoding of sorted rows
errors.guidance: recompute canonical freeze digest over sorted rows

errors.description: public operation or resource was added, removed, renamed, or renumbered without a new registry generation
errors.guidance: bump the registry generation and update the frozen public registry

errors.description: stable operation or resource identifier was reused for a different entity
errors.guidance: allocate a new unique stable identifier; never reuse stable IDs

errors.description: tombstoned operation or resource was resurrected into active registry
errors.guidance: allocate a new identifier; tombstoned entries remain permanently retired

errors.description: crosswalk or presentation surface references an unregistered operation
errors.guidance: register operation in frozen registry or correct surface reference

errors.description: graph algorithm row lacks declared complexity witness operations
errors.guidance: declare dominant operation complexity witness in graph algorithm registry

errors.description: graph algorithm row lacks declared output-size witness with bounds
errors.guidance: declare output-size witness with bounds or record explicit owner drift

errors.description: graph algorithm row lacks a deterministic CGSE tie-break rule
errors.guidance: specify a deterministic CGSE tie-break policy in graph algorithm registry

errors.description: graph algorithm projections differ between machine source and registry markdown mirror
errors.guidance: reconcile machine source and registry markdown projections

errors.description: graph algorithm stable identifier renumbered or superseded row not tombstoned
errors.guidance: restore stable algorithm identity and retain superseded rows as tombstones

errors.description: graph algorithm specifies an unregistered or nonexistent graph projection ID
errors.guidance: update algorithm projection to a registered projection ID from docs/GRAPH_ALGORITHM_ATLAS.md

errors.description: H2 decision artifact privacy class is not `private:property`, the only privacy class fss-core uses; raw or unredacted media included (code `invalid_privacy_class`)
errors.guidance: supply the authorized privacy class; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: H2 redaction transform is not a recognized `transform:*` token or is incompatible with the artifact kind (code `invalid_redaction_transform`)
errors.guidance: apply a recognized transform compatible with the artifact kind

errors.description: same key used with different request digest
errors.guidance: reject permanently

errors.description: boundary converted an internal panic to structured crash receipt
errors.guidance: quarantine, preserve support bundle

errors.description: knowledge state registry or markdown documentation file is missing or corrupt
errors.guidance: repair or restore knowledge state registry file

errors.description: knowledge state registry digest does not match canonical encoding of metadata and rows
errors.guidance: recompute canonical knowledge state registry digest

errors.description: knowledge state registry digest diverged from pinned baseline freeze digest
errors.guidance: restore frozen knowledge state registry or bump generation

errors.description: knowledge state registry generation diverged from baseline generation
errors.guidance: assign expected generation to knowledge state registry

errors.description: non-known knowledge state illegally authorizes irreversible effect
errors.guidance: restrict irreversible effect authorization strictly to known state

errors.description: knowledge state row lacks a mandatory field or is empty/corrupt
errors.guidance: declare all mandatory fields in knowledge state row

errors.description: knowledge state registry row drift between machine registry and markdown
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/knowledge_states.json and registries/AGENT_CONTRACTS.md

errors.description: knowledge state stable identifier was reused or renumbered for a different entity
errors.guidance: allocate a new unique stable identifier; never reuse stable IDs

errors.description: laboratory target root directory already contains files
errors.guidance: choose an empty or new target root directory

errors.description: effect lease fence is not current
errors.guidance: re-prepare under fresh lease

errors.description: durable ledger batch identity already committed with different content
errors.guidance: reject input; stable batch IDs are never reused

errors.description: journal byte offset or file length exceeds addressable 64-bit bounds
errors.guidance: archive or rotate journal; no in-place append possible

errors.description: batch basis anchor is not the committed anchor at its sequence
errors.guidance: reject input; foreign lineage, epoch, or state root

errors.description: committed batch identity reused with different content
errors.guidance: reject input; stable batch IDs are never reused

errors.description: batch delta count, child count, or text field exceeds the canonical batch bound
errors.guidance: reject input; split or repair the producer

errors.description: committed-batch capacity of the oracle is exhausted
errors.guidance: archive or rotate before appending

errors.description: declared batch digest does not match batch content
errors.guidance: reject input; never retry unchanged

errors.description: exact batch is already committed at the reported sequence
errors.guidance: no retry; batch is already canonical

errors.description: one batch carries more than one delta for the same object
errors.guidance: reject input; merge or split deltas

errors.description: canonical encoding of a digest input exceeded its encoder bound
errors.guidance: reject input; repair the oversized field

errors.description: delta generations do not follow the committed object generation
errors.guidance: reject input; re-prepare against the head

errors.description: ledger oracle limit or site lineage outside its admitted range
errors.guidance: repair configuration; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: successor anchor lineage, epoch, or sequence does not follow its basis
errors.guidance: reject input; re-prepare against the head

errors.description: batch deltas or child roots are not in strictly increasing canonical order
errors.guidance: reject input; re-prepare canonically

errors.description: batch would exceed the live-object capacity of the oracle
errors.guidance: archive or rotate before appending

errors.description: anchor-pinned read named an anchor that is not committed in this history
errors.guidance: resnapshot from a committed anchor of this lineage

errors.description: anchor-pinned read requested a sequence beyond the committed head
errors.guidance: wait for commit or read at a committed anchor

errors.description: commit sequence space is exhausted
errors.guidance: archive or rotate; no in-place append possible

errors.description: batch basis is beyond the head; predecessor batches are missing
errors.guidance: supply predecessors in canonical order, then retry

errors.description: staged batch was validated against a head that has since moved or another history
errors.guidance: stage again against the current head

errors.description: declared successor state root does not match the applied deltas
errors.guidance: reject input; never retry unchanged

errors.description: another batch already committed on the same basis (first committer wins)
errors.guidance: rebase onto the current head and prepare a new batch

errors.description: mixed or stale model/index generation
errors.guidance: rebuild/retry at coherent generation

errors.description: malformed/out-of-bounds model output
errors.guidance: reject output; terminate/quarantine generation

errors.description: model generation not runnable
errors.guidance: route to registered fallback or degrade

errors.description: negative evidence binary ledger corrupt magic, checksum, or truncated data
errors.guidance: repair corrupt ledger binary or restore from canonical backup

errors.description: negative evidence ledger changed between read and publish on every bounded attempt
errors.guidance: identify the concurrent writer, then retry the append explicitly

errors.description: negative evidence evaluated during an uncertified coverage gap
errors.guidance: ensure continuous coverage witness; absence during gap is never evidence

errors.description: negative evidence ledger contains duplicate stable entry identifier
errors.guidance: allocate unique stable entry identifier; never duplicate IDs

errors.description: attempted operation on or with a permanently tombstoned negative entry
errors.guidance: do not operate on tombstoned negative-evidence entries

errors.description: negative evidence entry or field exceeds declared capacity limit
errors.guidance: bound entry string length or shared failure domain count

errors.description: negative evidence ledger init target already exists
errors.guidance: choose a new path; init never overwrites a ledger

errors.description: negative evidence ledger file has a link count other than one, so an atomic publish would update only one of its names
errors.guidance: keep the ledger under a single name (use a symlink for aliases) before appending

errors.description: negative evidence ledger lock file is held by another writer or was left stale by a crashed writer
errors.guidance: retry after the other writer finishes; remove a stale lock only after confirming no writer is running

errors.description: negative evidence ledger file does not exist
errors.guidance: create the ledger with `fss negative-evidence init` before appending

errors.description: negative evidence ledger entry bytes carry an unknown tag, an invalid value, or a count beyond its declared bound
errors.guidance: restore the ledger from a canonical backup; never guess field values

errors.description: negative evidence entry lacks a certifying coverage witness
errors.guidance: provide a valid certifying coverage witness; absence without witness is never evidence

errors.description: locally certified negative evidence lacks a proof hash, a retained evidence reference, or the evidence its knowledge state requires
errors.guidance: supply the proof hash and retained evidence reference, or record the entry as not locally certified

errors.description: negative evidence ledger entries are not in strictly increasing canonical order
errors.guidance: sort entries strictly by stable ID

errors.description: candidate retry or promotion attempted without meeting revival condition
errors.guidance: satisfy documented revival condition before promoting candidate

errors.description: coverage witness does not certify complete negative predicate absence
errors.guidance: verify coverage domain and predicate certification

errors.description: negative evidence binary ledger format version is unknown or unsupported
errors.guidance: refuse unknown version; never guess ledger encoding format

errors.description: negative evidence entry semantic validation failed
errors.guidance: provide valid required fields conforming to negative evidence contract

errors.description: attempted non-monotone uncertainty narrowing violating FORMAL-010
errors.guidance: preserve monotone widening; retain sync evidence

errors.description: operation execution failed with expected domain error
errors.guidance: inspect error details and apply recovery guidance

errors.description: error identity does not conform to stable ERR pattern
errors.guidance: fix error identity to match stable registry format

errors.description: tombstone: superseded by `ERR-EFFECT-INDETERMINATE-001`
errors.guidance: historical duplicate preserved for audit; indeterminate outcomes must use Indeterminate variant

errors.description: operation outcome state transition or representation is invalid
errors.guidance: inspect outcome payload and repair state machine

errors.description: tombstone: superseded by `ERR-COVERAGE-UNKNOWN-001`
errors.guidance: historical duplicate preserved for audit; canonical target is `ERR-COVERAGE-UNKNOWN-001`

errors.description: tombstone: superseded by `ERR-PRECONDITION-STALE-001`
errors.guidance: historical duplicate preserved for audit; canonical target is `ERR-PRECONDITION-STALE-001`

errors.description: pending unresolved operation must be reconciled before further mutation
errors.guidance: reconcile pending sequence before retry

errors.description: operation budget or deadline expired before completion
errors.guidance: retry with higher budget or backoff

errors.description: tombstone: superseded by `ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001`
errors.guidance: historical duplicate preserved for audit; canonical target is `ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001`

errors.description: surveillance operation not registered in time uncertainty budget catalog
errors.guidance: register operation tolerance before evaluation

errors.description: plan anchor changed before commit
errors.guidance: re-plan; never auto-commit changed intent

errors.description: required redaction could not be applied
errors.guidance: fail closed at restricted boundary

errors.description: provenance registry or markdown documentation file is missing or corrupt
errors.guidance: repair or restore provenance registry file

errors.description: provenance registry digest does not match canonical encoding of metadata and rows
errors.guidance: recompute canonical provenance registry digest

errors.description: provenance registry digest diverged from pinned baseline freeze digest
errors.guidance: restore frozen provenance registry or bump generation

errors.description: provenance registry generation diverged from baseline generation
errors.guidance: assign expected generation to provenance registry

errors.description: provenance class row lacks a mandatory field or is empty/corrupt
errors.guidance: declare all mandatory fields in provenance class row

errors.description: provenance registry row drift between machine registry and markdown
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/provenance_classes.json and registries/AGENT_CONTRACTS.md

errors.description: provenance semantic invariant violation: non-permissible irreversible authorization, missing anchors, or score flattening
errors.guidance: enforce provenance orthogonality and class-specific evidence/authorization gates

errors.description: provenance class stable identifier was reused or renumbered for a different entity
errors.guidance: allocate a new unique stable identifier; never reuse stable IDs

errors.description: root reachability is already canonical; nothing to prepare
errors.guidance: no retry; root is already ledgered

errors.description: canonical ledger already names a different root or family for the slot; nothing appended
errors.guidance: repair the ledger identity explicitly; never overwrite either record

errors.description: root is durable and its reachability append became indeterminate
errors.guidance: reconcile the ledger append before any retry

errors.description: a root-ledger fault-injection cut point fired after the root became durable
errors.guidance: reopen both owners to reconcile

errors.description: slot holds no durable root; its reachability is never committed to the ledger
errors.guidance: publish durably or reopen to reconcile first

errors.description: offered batch is not the reachability batch of the slot's durable root
errors.guidance: reject input; prepare against the durable root

errors.description: reconciling an indeterminate ledger append failed
errors.guidance: repair ledger storage, then reconcile again

errors.description: an indeterminate ledger append must be reconciled before root-ledger work
errors.guidance: reconcile the pending ledger append

errors.description: slot cannot be expressed as a stable ledger object or batch identity
errors.guidance: reject input; choose a slot within the ledgered slot bound

errors.description: root is durable but the ledger refused or could not prepare its reachability batch; explicit pending-ledger state
errors.guidance: follow the nested cause, then retry the idempotent ledger commit

errors.description: manifest child count or directory entry count exceeds the configured bound
errors.guidance: reject input; split the manifest or repair the layout

errors.description: slot holds a root record that failed reopen verification
errors.guidance: repair or quarantine the broken record; never overwrite it

errors.description: publication was cancelled before the root rename; nothing is visible
errors.guidance: retry idempotently when resumed

errors.description: configured root or tombstone capacity of the local publisher is exhausted
errors.guidance: archive or rotate before publishing

errors.description: removing a temporary publication file failed after an earlier error; both errors are carried
errors.guidance: repair storage, discard orphaned temps, then retry idempotently

errors.description: a referenced object failed digest verification; root not visible
errors.guidance: repair or restage the named object, then retry idempotently

errors.description: a durable tombstone record failed verification on open
errors.guidance: repair the tombstone store; open fails closed

errors.description: tombstone record lacks a deletion authority witness
errors.guidance: supply a verified deletion authority witness

errors.description: canonical encoding of a publication record exceeded its encoder bound
errors.guidance: reject input; repair the oversized field

errors.description: root was renamed into place but its directory fsync failed; durability unknown
errors.guidance: reopen to reconcile before any retry

errors.description: a fault-injection cut point fired and the instance behaves as a dead process
errors.guidance: reopen to reconcile

errors.description: local publication limits are zero, inconsistent, or above a format maximum
errors.guidance: repair configuration; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a publication filesystem operation failed before the root rename
errors.guidance: bounded retry after repairing storage; nothing is visible

errors.description: a publication directory or record path has the wrong file type or is occupied unexpectedly
errors.guidance: repair the layout; nothing is overwritten

errors.description: another owner holds the exclusive publication lock
errors.guidance: wait for the owner to close; never share the root

errors.description: manifest root does not match its canonical body or its staged read-back
errors.guidance: reject input; rebuild the manifest canonically

errors.description: an orphaned temporary record from an interrupted publication occupies the path
errors.guidance: discard classified orphans, then retry idempotently

errors.description: publisher observed a crash or indeterminate outcome and refuses further work
errors.guidance: reopen to reconcile

errors.description: root rename was reported failed and rolling back the possibly renamed record failed; visibility unknown, slot marked indeterminate
errors.guidance: reopen to reconcile; the slot is refused until its record and indeterminate marker are repaired

errors.description: slot already holds a different visible root
errors.guidance: reject input; publish the new root under a new slot

errors.description: publication slot name is empty, too long, or outside the slot grammar
errors.guidance: reject input; choose a registered slot name

errors.description: the staging spool refused an object stage, verify, or read
errors.guidance: follow the nested spool failure; no root was made visible

errors.description: a different tombstone record is already durable for the object
errors.guidance: reject input; tombstones are immutable

errors.description: object is reachable from a visible root and cannot be tombstoned locally
errors.guidance: run deletion closure through its owner; no silent unpublish

errors.description: tombstone rename was reported failed and rolling back the possibly renamed record failed; visibility unknown
errors.guidance: reopen to reconcile; the tombstone is refused until its record and indeterminate marker are repaired

errors.description: a referenced object carries a durable tombstone; root not visible
errors.guidance: reject input; tombstoned objects are never republished

errors.description: custody of a referenced object could not be determined; root not visible
errors.guidance: reopen to reconcile storage, then retry idempotently

errors.description: child staging incomplete; root not visible
errors.guidance: idempotent retry or collect children

errors.description: region/process failed to drain
errors.guidance: block shutdown/upgrade claim; force isolation path

errors.description: semantic decision fingerprint differs from proof
errors.guidance: block claim/release

errors.description: malformed JSON syntax, duplicate keys, or encoding corruption in robot docs or registry
errors.guidance: repair malformed input; ensure canonical encoding

errors.description: cataloged operations, views, or resources drift across registries
errors.guidance: reconcile registry definitions before generating docs

errors.description: generated robot documentation markdown or json artifact missing
errors.guidance: generate robot docs with scripts/generate_robot_docs.py

errors.description: suspected secret, credential, token, or local filesystem path detected in registry text
errors.guidance: remove sensitive data and sanitize registry text

errors.description: robot documentation diverges from authoritative machine registries
errors.guidance: regenerate robot docs with scripts/generate_robot_docs.py

errors.description: documented operation references unregistered capability, schema, or error identity
errors.guidance: register referenced entity in authoritative registry before generating docs

errors.description: input durable schema version unsupported
errors.guidance: migrate with registered path or reject

errors.description: secret handle cannot be resolved
errors.guidance: repair/rotate; bounded retry if provider transient

errors.description: capsule source bytes does not match custody source bytes
errors.guidance: align capsule and custody byte count

errors.description: sensor capsule classification requires a sensor capsule payload
errors.guidance: provide sensor capsule or change classification

errors.description: retained source custody storage handle is empty
errors.guidance: provide non-empty sanitized storage handle

errors.description: source evidence record missing authoritative anchor
errors.guidance: attach authoritative anchor; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: not-retained source evidence capsule cannot claim non-zero source bytes, non-zero frame count, or non-zero source digest
errors.guidance: zero capsule bytes/digest/frames or mark retained

errors.description: source evidence not retained cannot bind a continuity witness
errors.guidance: omit witness or retain source evidence

errors.description: not-retained source evidence must declare an explicit omission reason
errors.guidance: supply explicit omission reason; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: raw wire packets classification cannot carry a sensor capsule payload
errors.guidance: omit capsule or change classification

errors.description: retained source evidence cannot declare an omission reason
errors.guidance: remove omission reason or mark not-retained

errors.description: source evidence statement is empty or exceeds 512 bytes
errors.guidance: constrain statement to 1..=512 UTF-8 bytes

errors.description: retained source custody storage handle contains forbidden absolute path or url
errors.guidance: provide relative or content-addressed storage handle

errors.description: retained source custody storage handle contains a character outside ASCII `[A-Za-z0-9._-]` and `/` (including space, control, bidi, format and non-ASCII characters)
errors.guidance: supply a handle made only of allow-listed characters

errors.description: retained source custody storage handle has an empty segment (doubled or trailing `/`)
errors.guidance: remove the empty segment; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: tombstoned, no longer emitted: superseded by the EMPTY-SEGMENT, OVER-LENGTH and DISALLOWED-CHARACTER storage handle identities
errors.guidance: not applicable; retained so the stable ID is never reused

errors.description: retained source custody storage handle exceeds 4096 bytes
errors.guidance: shorten the storage handle to at most 4096 bytes

errors.description: retained source custody storage handle contains `%`; percent-encoding is refused rather than decoded
errors.guidance: supply the literal allow-listed handle without percent-encoding

errors.description: retained source custody storage handle has a `.` or `..` segment
errors.guidance: remove path traversal components from storage handle

errors.description: unknown source evidence classification string token
errors.guidance: supply a registered classification token

errors.description: unknown source custody binary wire tag
errors.guidance: supply a registered custody tag

errors.description: unknown omission reason string token
errors.guidance: supply a registered omission reason token

errors.description: unsupported source evidence binary wire format version
errors.guidance: encode with current supported format version

errors.description: continuity witness cannot equal source digest
errors.guidance: supply distinct continuity witness

errors.description: continuity witness classification requires a continuity witness digest
errors.guidance: provide continuity witness or change classification

errors.description: gaps/jitter exceed contract
errors.guidance: degrade coverage; bounded recovery

errors.description: adapter accepted but no decodable frame before budget
errors.guidance: reconnect or fail; never claim coverage

errors.description: capture or transit interval earliest bound exceeds latest bound
errors.guidance: correct interval bounds before evaluation

operations.name: session.open
operations.purpose: negotiate principal, mission, authority, privacy projection, budgets, views, and the initial SituationCapsule

operations.name: session.resume
operations.purpose: restore an explicit workspace/handoff root, compare it with current state, and enumerate stale or invalidated assumptions

operations.name: session.orient
operations.purpose: return the smallest sufficient current SituationCapsule for the mission, authority, and budget

operations.name: session.follow
operations.purpose: stream meaningful deltas and obligation progress from an exact continuation cursor

operations.name: query
operations.purpose: execute a bounded typed or natural-language-compiled read over one anchor with completeness and cost receipts

operations.name: investigate
operations.purpose: create or advance a durable case with competing hypotheses, evidence tasks, work claims, discriminators, and stop rules

operations.name: plan
operations.purpose: compile a desired outcome or information objective into an immutable witnessed contingent plan without crossing the effect boundary

operations.name: commit
operations.purpose: revalidate and start the exact prepared plan under idempotency, leases, fencing, approval, and terminal-proof obligations

operations.name: wait
operations.purpose: observe cases, plans, effects, transfers, and obligations until a predicate, deadline, or meaningful delta fires

operations.name: cancel
operations.purpose: request, drain, reconcile or compensate, and finalize owned work without erasing its durable record

operations.name: explain
operations.purpose: answer why, why-not, what-changed, or what-if with a minimal evidence/decision subgraph and expansion handles

operations.name: handoff
operations.purpose: publish a root-last portable capsule containing mission, workspace, cases, plans, obligations, budgets, authority, uncertainty, and continuations

operations.name: feedback
operations.purpose: record a correction, outcome signal, adjudication, or evidence-linked learning proposal without silently changing active truth or policy

operations.name: doctor
operations.purpose: diagnose deployment, evidence, cognition, workspace, cases, obligations, and protocol consistency and produce sealed repair affordances

schemas.compatibilityRule: exact tuple only; invalidator transitions revoke/degrade
adapter identity binds protocol profile, isolation mode, credentials, and capabilities
value, cost, risk, authority, reversibility, invalidators, alternatives, and expected proof remain decomposed
anchor, knowledge/provenance status, coverage, omissions, budget, evidence, affordances, and continuity remain explicit
cursor is exact and root-verified; fenced lifetime and progress cannot be reinterpreted or replayed
protocol, schema/ontology/operation/view/capability/error/cost registry digests, producer release, and accepted nightly remain exact
step types, witnesses, effect boundaries, contingencies, budgets, and decision digest remain immutable
original predictions, receipts, outcome, resource use, residual uncertainty, and attribution remain auditable
correction or outcome signal is evidence-linked and cannot directly mutate active policy
claim, epistemic state, evidence, assumptions, coverage, method receipts, and withdrawal state remain auditable
mission, situation, cases, plans, obligations, unknowns, authority, budgets, continuation, and expiry remain complete
competing hypotheses and support, contradiction, missing evidence, predictions, and falsifiers remain addressable
knowledge state, provenance, evidence, validity, uncertainty, and decision relevance remain separate
applicability, evidence, counterexamples, harmful outcomes, validation, expiry, and promotion remain explicit

terminal, contradiction, coverage, plan-invalidation, and effect-uncertainty deltas cannot be coalesced away; superseded by `SCHEMA-AGENT-DELTA-002` (`fss.agent_meaningful_delta.v2`), which adds the required typed removal `removedClaimIds`; v1 records stay immutable

terminal, contradiction, coverage, plan-invalidation, and effect-uncertainty deltas cannot be coalesced away; a basis cell absent from the result is a typed removal (`removedClaimIds`), never a changed cell carrying its basis value; supersedes `SCHEMA-AGENT-DELTA-001`

hard constraints, budgets, authority, success, failure, stop predicates, and terminal proof are immutable
compiled interpretation, targets, authority, privacy, cost, and output view are reviewable and bounded
contract basis, operation, lifecycle, anchor/workspace preconditions, view, targets, typed payload, budget, authority/privacy request, continuation, idempotency, and taint remain explicit
operation, session, anchors, outcome, payload, errors, budgets, proof, continuation, and safe retry remain explicit
session identity, authority, privacy projection, view, continuations, and expiry remain explicit
workspace revisions are immutable and resume records stale and invalidated state
task-relative selection changes only through a new frame and selection witness
scope, basis, owner, lease, progress, result, expiry, and no-effect-authority property remain explicit
nominal estimate, certified core and absences, material alternatives, adversarial residuals, unresolved dimensions, discriminators, and selection witness remain separate and anchor-pinned

terminal/indeterminate outcome and outstanding effects preserved
additions compatible; changed meaning requires new schema
diagnostic schema immutable; errors follow structured envelope
one emitted expansion slot maps to one exact descriptor revision, purpose, level, and descriptor-owned full cost
every emitted expansion slot is bound exactly once; missing, duplicate, unexpected, stale, or ambient descriptors fail closed
absence claims require declared domain and stop reason
hard constraints and alternatives retained; no silent rewrite

bounded and secret-free

old proof bundles remain replayable or explicitly unsupported
basis/new anchors and ordered delta identities preserved
causal evidence graph over capsules, identities, model receipts, and revisions; enum widening for relation additions (sensor_tamper, sensor_integrity_restoration)
episode signature, signals, failures, costs, applicability, decay, and privacy remain auditable
algorithm/projection/policy identity and output digest preserved
case revisions preserve question, decision, hypotheses, probes, stop rules, and residual uncertainty
baseline JPEG fixture suite manifest recording dimensions, subsampling, quality, file sha256, source pixel sha256, and float IDCT reconstruction metrics

input/model/plan/backend/numeric/budget/outcome and output identities preserved

ledger entries, verification result, epistemic state derived from entry knowledge states, and degradation stay explicit; not an agent response envelope
state monotonicity; idempotency identity preserved
immutable prepared operation; intent, obligation, and predicate preserved
provider-issued failure receipt; nonce and error reason preserved
provider-issued observation receipt; verified by lookup, never recomputable
primary/support artifact digests, claim boundary, and signing state immutable
native target/toolchain/source/lock/manifest/smoke identities immutable
same source/sibling/toolchain identity required for aggregation
stage inventory and content digests preserved exactly

selected and omitted classes, critical preservation, stop reason, and expansion slots remain explicit
pack basis, view, items, compression receipt, token count, continuation, digest, and expansion slots are immutable

immutable subject, exact descriptor revision, contract basis, authority anchor, level, and ladder policy remain inseparable
